progressSummary: Audited V3-08 requires repair; WIP baseline preserved when a safe delta existed.

openFindings.problem: The Android E2E script unconditionally requires the CHORESCORE_APK_PATH environment variable, but the trusted finalizer workflow invokes 'npm run e2e:android' without setting it (the workflow pre-installs the APK via 'adb install -r "$apk"' in the emulator step). The script's own docstring declares the variable 'optional if already installed', but the implementation throws 'Unreadable CHORESCORE_APK_PATH: undefined' at the first check of the try block. The trusted finalizer would fail at the Android API 35 install/launch/golden-path step, reopen V3-08 again, and the repair objective (make the trusted finalizer pass) would not be met.
openFindings.evidence: scripts/e2e-android.js line 22: 'const apkPath = process.env.CHORESCORE_APK_PATH;' and line 205: 'if (!apkPath || !fs.existsSync(apkPath)) throw new Error(`Unreadable CHORESCORE_APK_PATH: ${apkPath}`);'. .github/workflows/chorescore-v3-finalize.yml emulator step (lines 84-94): 'script: | set -euo pipefail; apk=$(find android/app/build/outputs/apk/release -type f -name '*.apk' | head -1); adb install -r "$apk"; npm run e2e:android' — no CHORESCORE_APK_PATH env var anywhere in the workflow (grep confirms). Simulation with the env var deleted reproduces the throw and exit 1. The script's docstring line 14 states 'CHORESCORE_APK_PATH — path to the APK (optional if already installed)', contradicting the code.
openFindings.requiredFix: Make the APK path optional when the package is already installed: check 'pm list packages <packageName>' first and only require/use apkPath when an install is actually needed, or auto-locate the APK under android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/ when CHORESCORE_APK_PATH is unset. The implementation must match the documented contract ('optional if already installed').
openFindings.verification: In the finalizer environment (no CHORESCORE_APK_PATH, package pre-installed via adb install -r), 'npm run e2e:android' must reach the golden-path steps instead of throwing at the first guard; the trusted finalizer run must pass the Android API 35 install/launch/golden-path step.
